document.about: Cree Lighting CR4T downlight spec sheet, Canada (Word-made, 3 pages). Its accessories are two boxed tables set one under the other, under 3 pt apart.

notes: 2026-11-25 (#197): the `Trims` box (two columns parted at one place) and the `Housings` box under it (two columns parted at another) touch, their rules a hair apart. Read as one drawing, their dividers made three columns neither has: `Trims` became a title over the whole and `Housings` a band partway down, the trims' second column read as the third.

checks.issue: #197: the trims' second column was the merged grid's third.
